results.title: Corporate Chef
results.description: Position Overview: With a passion for innovation and a dedication to culinary excellence, we're seeking a talented Chef who will be responsible for overseeing culinary operations across our restaurant group. You will work closely with our executive team to develop and execute menus, maintain high standards of food quality and consistency, and ensure the profitability of our culinary operations. Additionally, you will provide leadership and mentorship to our chefs and kitchen staff, fostering a culture of creativity, collaboration, and continuous improvement. Key Responsibilities:Develop and execute innovative and seasonal menus that reflect our culinary vision and showcase the highest quality ingredients.Collaborate with our executive team to develop and implement culinary strategies that drive business growth and profitability.Oversee menu development, recipe standardization, and food costing to ensure profitability and consistency across all locations.Train, mentor, and inspire our culinary team, fostering a culture of excellence, creativity, and teamwork.Ensure compliance with food safety and sanitation standards, as well as local health regulations.Stay abreast of industry trends, emerging ingredients, and culinary techniques, and incorporate them into our menus and operations.Collaborate with suppliers and vendors to source the freshest and highest quality ingredients while maintaining cost efficiency.Conduct regular kitchen inspections and audits to maintain cleanliness, organization, and safety standards. Qualifications:Minimum of 6 years of experience in culinary leadership roles, preferably in a multi-unit restaurant or hospitality environment.Culinary degree or equivalent certification from a recognized culinary institution.Proven track record of developing and executing successful menus that drive business growth and customer satisfaction.Strong leadership and management skills, with the ability to inspire and motivate teams to achieve excellence.Exceptional culinary skills and a passion for creativity, innovation, and quality.Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively with cross-functional teams.Solid understanding of food costing, inventory management, and kitchen operations.Knowledge of food safety and sanitation standards, with relevant certifications preferred.Ability to thrive in a fast-paced, dynamic environment and adapt to changing priorities. Benefits:Competitive salary range of $150,000 - $200,000Metric-based bonus program. Comprehensive benefits package, including health, dental, and vision insurance.Paid vacation and paid sick time. A dynamic and collaborative work environment with a passionate team dedicated to culinary excellence.Generous discounts on dining at our restaurants. results.title: Executive Sous Chef
results.description: Muse is a blend of artful experiences that range from our culinary presentation and service, to the colorful wine collection and craft-made cocktails, all married with a cultural, art–filled environment. Together, it sets the tone for a unique dining experience for Stevens Point and central Wisconsin. Muse is currently seeking a talented and experienced individual to join the team as an Executive Sous Chef. If you have a passion for cooking, leading the kitchen, and have excellent communication skills, this position may be a fit for you! What You'll Do As an Executive Sous Chef, you will: Provide leadership and guidance to the culinary teams and fosters a culture of creativity, collaboration, and continuous improvement. Works closely with the Executive Chef to help develop innovative menus and concepts that reflect culinary trends and guest preferences. Collaborate with the Executive Chef and Restaurant Managers to develop seasonal menus, daily specials, and catering offerings that showcase farm-to-table ingredients, culinary expertise, and creativity. Develops menu concepts from start to finish, creates menu, budgets menu cost, and presents final tasting to leadership team. Monitors menu performance, gathers feedback, and make adjustments as necessary to enhance guest satisfaction and profitability. Mentor and train kitchen staff in culinary techniques, food preparation methods, and sanitation practices. Diseminates recipe instructions and creates daily workflows needed for new menu rollout. Fosters a culture of learning and development, providing opportunities for growth and advancement within the culinary team. Oversee the larger scope of day-to-day kitchen operations, including food preparation, production, and presentation, ensuring adherence to quality standards, food safety regulations, and cost control measures. Implements efficient workflows and procedures to optimize kitchen efficiency and productivity. Manage food inventory levels, procurement, and vendor relationships to ensure adequate supply levels while minimizing waste and controlling costs/delivery time. Conduct regular inventory audits and implements strategies to optimize inventory turnover, product rotation, and minimize shrinkage. Maintain high standards of food quality, consistency, and presentation, conducting regular tastings and inspections to uphold Sentry's reputation for service and quality. Address any issues or concerns promptly, implementing corrective actions as needed. Ensure compliance with all state, federal, and industrial health, safety, and sanitation regulations, conducting regular inspections and team training to uphold the highest standards of cleanliness and hygiene in the kitchen. Administer human resource-related activities including timely performance and salary reviews. Ensure all subordinates adhere to human resources policies and practices. Completes scheduling & payroll processes for assigned team members. Additionally, You Will Work closely with Restaurant Manager and front-of-house staff to deliver exceptional dining experiences that exceed guest expectations. Collaborate on special events, promotions, and themed dinners to enhance guest engagement and satisfaction. Responsible for meticulously organizing the food items required for the daily menu within the framework of each restaurant's unique concept, ensuring seamless execution and adherence to culinary standards. Oversee and providing leadership to the back-of-house staff when the Executive Chef is unavailable, ensuring smooth operations and maintaining high standards of performance in their absence. Actively support and cultivate a culture of "concierge-like" service by consistently delivering a personalized and exceptional level of service ensuring customer satisfaction. Partner with Executive Chef to hold daily line-up meetings to go over shift expectations. Perform other job-related duties as assigned from time to time. What It Takes Technical degree from Culinary Institute or equivalent work experienceMinimum of 4 years of relevant work experienceTIPS certification requiredServSafe certification requiredStrong leadership and communication skills, with the ability to inspire and motivate a diverse team. Excellent organizational and time management skills, with the ability to prioritize tasks and manage multiple projects simultaneously. Knowledge of culinary techniques, food trends, industry best practices, and all aspects of food preparation. Wood burning oven experience desirable. Farm-to-table experience desirable. Proficient with Microsoft Excel. Experience in banquet preparation and planning. Ability to work flexible scheduling including early mornings, nights, weekends, and holidays as needed. What You'll Receive At Sentry, your total rewards go beyond competitive compensation. Below are some benefits and perks that you’ll receive. Competitive Compensation to reward you for your hard workEligibility for a Quarterly Performance BonusGenerous Holiday Pay, Paid-Time Off and Floating Holidays for you to enjoy time “out of the office”Group Medical, Dental, Vision and Life Insurance to encourage a healthy lifestyle401 (K) match after 1 year of service to help fund your futureAssociate discounted shift meals and golf ratesFree Wellness Center MembershipExtensive Work-Life Resources to lend a helping hand. About Sentry We take great pride in making Forbes’ list of America’s Best Midsize Employers. A lot of different factors go into that honor, many of which contribute to your job satisfaction. Our bright future is built on a long track record of success. We got our start in 1904 and have been helping businesses succeed and protect their futures ever since. Because of the trust placed in us, we’re one of the largest and financially strongest mutual insurance companies in the United States. We’re rated A+ by A.M. Best, the industry's leading rating authority. Our headquarters is in Stevens Point, Wisconsin, with offices located throughout the United States. From sales to claims, and information technology to marketing, we enjoy a rewarding and challenging work environment with opportunities for ongoing professional development and growth. Get ready to own your future at Sentry. Opportunities await! Who To Contact Brianna.Tucker@Sentry.com Brianna Tucker Equal Opportunity Employer SentryWorld is an Equal Opportunity Employer. results.description: Job Description:As a Chef Consultant with our restaurant group, you will play a pivotal role in shaping the culinary direction and success of our establishments. You will work closely with our culinary teams, providing expert guidance, creative input, and strategic direction to ensure our restaurants maintain the highest standards of excellence. Responsibilities:Menu Development: Collaborate with our culinary teams to create innovative and enticing menus that reflect our brand identity and cater to the preferences of our target audience.Recipe Development: Develop and refine recipes that showcase the unique flavors and ingredients of our specialty restaurants, while also meeting quality and cost-efficiency standards.Kitchen Operations: Assess and optimize kitchen operations to enhance efficiency, consistency, and quality of food preparation and service.Training and Development: Provide hands-on training, mentorship, and support to kitchen staff to ensure adherence to best practices and culinary standards.Quality Assurance: Conduct regular inspections and quality assessments to maintain consistency and uphold food safety standards across all our establishments.Vendor Relationships: Source and establish relationships with quality suppliers and vendors to ensure the procurement of fresh, sustainable, and high-quality ingredients.Trend Analysis: Stay abreast of culinary trends, industry developments, and consumer preferences to inform menu and concept evolution.Guest Feedback: Solicit and analyze customer feedback to identify areas for improvement and innovation in our culinary offerings. Requirements:Culinary Expertise: Proven experience as an Executive Chef or culinary professional, in an innovative leadership role within the restaurant industry.Innovative Thinking: Creative flair and a passion for culinary innovation, with a track record of developing unique and memorable dishes.Strategic Vision: Ability to conceptualize and execute culinary strategies that align with business objectives and market trends.Communication Skills: Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively with cross-functional teams.Leadership Abilities: Strong leadership qualities, including the ability to motivate, inspire, and mentor kitchen staff to achieve excellence.Adaptability: Flexibility to adapt to changing priorities and environments in a fast-paced, dynamic industry.Attention to Detail: Meticulous attention to detail and a commitment to upholding the highest standards of quality and consistency.Culinary Education: Formal culinary education or relevant certifications are desirable but not essential, with a strong emphasis on practical experience and demonstrated expertise.Benefits:Competitive salary commensurate with experienceOpportunity to work with a dynamic and passionate teamPotential for career growth and advancement within our organizationEmployee discounts and perks at our specialty restaurantsInsurance benefits + more Join us in our culinary journey and help us continue to redefine the art of dining. If you have a passion for food, a drive for excellence, and a taste for innovation, we want to hear from you! Apply now and become a part of our culinary legacy.

reasoning.cv_summary: Senior-level culinary professional with 12 years of experience, holding Sous Chef and Line Cook titles in upscale restaurants, with a Bachelor's in Culinary Management and demonstrated strengths in menu development, recipe costing, culinary staff supervision, high-volume service, and supplier/cost management.

job_explanations.title: Corporate Chef
job_explanations.match_reason: This is a strong match. The role requires minimum 6 years of culinary leadership experience; the candidate has 12 years. Core requirements — menu development, recipe costing (listed as 'Recipe Costing' in CV), culinary staff supervision, supplier contracts, seasonal ingredient use, and cost reduction — all appear directly in the CVProfile. The candidate's upscale restaurant background aligns with STARR's multi-unit fine dining environment. The only notable gap is the absence of a formal culinary degree or certification, which is listed as a qualification, though the candidate holds a Bachelor's in Culinary Management which may satisfy this requirement.

job_explanations.title: Chef Consultant
job_explanations.match_reason: This is a strong match. The role requires proven executive chef or senior culinary leadership experience with expertise in menu development, recipe development, vendor relationships, training, and quality assurance — all of which are directly represented in the CVProfile through skills (Menu Development, Recipe Costing, Culinary Staff Supervision), domain keywords (Supplier Contracts, Quality Control, Culinary Training), and 12 years of upscale restaurant experience. The reranker score of 88 reflects this alignment. Formal culinary education is noted as desirable but not essential, and the candidate's Culinary Management degree addresses this.

job_explanations.title: Executive Chef
job_explanations.match_reason: This is a partial-to-strong match. The role requires a minimum of 5 years BOH leadership and 2 years as Executive Chef; the candidate has 12 years of experience but has held Sous Chef and Line Cook titles — not Executive Chef. This title gap is a moderate concern, though the candidate's senior experience level and breadth of skills (menu development, food costing, culinary staff supervision, high-volume service) closely align with the role's operational demands. The requirement for extensive private events and banquet experience is not evidenced in the CVProfile, which is a genuine gap.

job_explanations.title: Executive Sous Chef
job_explanations.match_reason: This is a strong match. The role is Mid-Senior level and requires a minimum of 4 years of relevant experience; the candidate has 12 years. The CVProfile directly covers the core requirements: menu development, recipe costing, culinary staff supervision, quality control, supplier contracts, and seasonal ingredient use. The candidate's Sous Chef title is the direct predecessor to this role. Two explicitly required certifications — TIPS and ServSafe — are absent from the CVProfile. Microsoft Excel proficiency is also required and not listed in the candidate's tools.

job_explanations.title: Sous Chef Fine Dining
job_explanations.match_reason: This is a strong match. The candidate's Sous Chef title directly corresponds to this role, and the fine dining upscale restaurant background aligns precisely with the establishment's positioning. Skills including culinary staff supervision, menu development, food presentation, high-volume service, and recipe costing map directly to the stated responsibilities. With 12 years of experience, the candidate is well above the minimum threshold. No hard certification requirements are stated as mandatory.

job_explanations.title: Chef de Cuisine
job_explanations.match_reason: This is a strong match. The role requires at least 2 years of culinary managerial experience and 3 years of culinary experience; the candidate far exceeds both with 12 years and a Sous Chef background. Key responsibilities — menu creation, seasonal ingredient use, staff supervision, kitchen budgeting, quality control, and prep station management — are all represented in the CVProfile. The resort/hospitality context is a slight departure from the candidate's pure upscale restaurant background, but the skill overlap is high.

job_explanations.title: Executive Chef - Corporate Dining
job_explanations.match_reason: This is a partial match. The role requires 8–10 years of related experience and the candidate's 12 years satisfies this. Skills in menu development, budgeting, culinary staff supervision, and quality control align well. However, the corporate dining/contract food service context differs from the candidate's upscale restaurant background, and the role explicitly requires ServSafe and Allergen Awareness certifications, which are absent from the CVProfile. MS Office proficiency is also required and not listed in the candidate's tools.

job_explanations.title: Sous Chef - LAVO Los Angeles
job_explanations.match_reason: This is a strong match. The role requires a minimum of 5 years at a high-volume, five-star quality operation; the candidate has 12 years in upscale restaurants with high-volume service as a listed skill. The Sous Chef title held by the candidate directly matches the role. Skills in menu development, recipe costing, culinary staff supervision, and food cost control align with the stated requirements. A food handling certification is required and is not present in the CVProfile. The reranker score of 72 is moderate but the core skill and title alignment is solid.

job_explanations.title: Sous Chef
job_explanations.match_reason: This is a strong match. The candidate's Sous Chef title and fine dining/upscale restaurant background directly align with this luxury property's requirements. Responsibilities including culinary staff supervision, food presentation, prep station management, menu development, and quality control are all present in the CVProfile. A culinary arts degree is listed as required; the candidate holds a Bachelor's in Culinary Management which should satisfy this. Basic Microsoft Word, Excel, and Outlook proficiency is required and not evidenced in the candidate's tools.

job_explanations.title: Sr. Chef Manager - Los Angeles, CA
job_explanations.match_reason: This is a partial match. The role requires five years of progressive culinary management experience and the candidate's 12 years exceeds this. Skills in menu development, budgeting, culinary staff supervision, and cost control align with the role's responsibilities. However, this is a senior living/contract dining environment, which is a different operational context from the candidate's upscale restaurant background. The role explicitly requires HACCP knowledge and P&L/financial reporting experience, neither of which appears in the CVProfile. MS Office and POS proficiency are also required and absent from the candidate's tools. The reranker score of 68 reflects the partial domain and tooling fit.

reasoning.recommendation: The candidate should prioritize obtaining a ServSafe certification and a food handling/TIPS certification, as these are explicitly required across multiple roles and represent the most consistent barrier to qualification. Adding Microsoft Office (particularly Excel) to their documented skill set would also remove a recurring gap flagged in several mid-senior culinary management positions.
